quiz_title: Web Design Advanced - Quiz 3: JS Basics & Data Outputs

questions.q: Which HTML element is used to house JavaScript scripts?
questions.exp: We insert Javascript code internally inside standard <script> tags, or link external files.

questions.q: Which data type stores true or false values in JavaScript?
questions.exp: Booleans represent conditional logical binary variables: true or false!

questions.q: Which output method logs diagnostic texts silently inside console inspectors?
questions.exp: console.log() prints messages to browser inspector logs, ideal for testing without interrupting users!

questions.q: How do you trigger a pop-up alert dialog window in JavaScript?
questions.exp: window.alert() stops browser scripts, showing a warning box with text and an OK button!

questions.q: Which DOM property changes the HTML content inside selected tags?
questions.exp: innerHTML lets you get or set the actual markup text nested inside HTML elements dynamically!
